items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: He had one called Henry Kimball, that was his bass player.

ctx.x: Oh yeah. I knew Bud Scott.

Bud Scott on the guitar. And Bud Scott stayed with him practically until his band broke up. The Robichaud was a left-handed violin player. Old John Robichaud. And he had... He had two Kimballs in his band, you know. He had one called Henry Kimball, that was his bass player. And Andrew Kimball. The trumpet player. Andrew Kimball and Henry Kimball. And Henry Kimball is still active playing now. He plays baseball and he's a... He's a... a... a...
a... a... Yeah. Well, I've been trying to think for three days of a trumpet player. I told Ralph the other day, it begins with K. from uptown. It went through my head. Keelan. Frank Keelan?
